subject: Optimize Toolkit: packaging options, quantization recommendations, and KV-cache savings
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@fastship.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit questions + packaging

Hi Sofia / Camila / Marcus,

Thanks for the call earlier — attaching our short usage dump (pilot-usage-estimates.csv) so you can see session lengths and peak QPS. A few things we need to resolve before procurement:

- Clear packaging options for a 6-week pilot then potential 12-month commit.
- Firm guidance on quantization tradeoffs: we run a mix of short interactions (10-60 tokens) and longer transcripts (700-1,200 tokens). Accuracy loss at int4 is a concern.
- How KV-cache behavior maps to unit economics (we expect a lot of prefix reuse).
- Any compliance constraints (we need assurance no cross-tenant caching for PII).

Also copying our legal team (legal@nebulaai.com) who will want a term sheet before pilot sign. Can you send a precise pilot offer (credits, discounts, expected token cost after batching/cache) and a short technical note on quantization and cache retention?

Appreciate it — Olivia

Attachment: pilot-usage-estimates.csv (CSV, 34 KB)

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@fastship.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit questions + packaging

Hi Olivia — thanks for the data dump. Quick read-through shows the exact mix you mentioned (many short queries, a non-trivial tail of long transcripts).

High-level proposal (I) so you have something concrete fast:
- Pilot: 2-week sandbox + 4-week production pilot with $30k in credits against hosted inference. Includes access to the Optimize toolkit (quantization recommendations, batching/caching advisor) and one week of 1:1 runtime tuning with Marcus.
- Post-pilot: three commit bands (Tier A: 25k/mo tokens commit; Tier B: 100k/mo; Tier C: 400k+/mo) with increasing volumetric discounts and dedicated KV-cache retention options for Tier B+.
- Quantization guidance: recommend testing int8 as default for production; evaluate int4 in an evaluation bucket for 10% sample traffic. For long transcripts int4 increases hallucination risk depending on model, so recommend hybrid approach.

On KV-cache: if your prefix reuse is >50% we typically see 30–40% token-cost reduction; accurate numbers will depend on TTL and session stickiness. We can instrument a cache-hit dashboard in week 1.

I'll attach a short packaging summary and a first-pass term sheet for your legal team. Can Marcus scope the tuning time and Camila produce a pricing sketch by EOD?

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: package-options-summary.pdf (PDF, 82 KB)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-17T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit questions + packaging

Sofia / Marcus — quick commercial structure draft to iterate with Olivia and legal: 

1) Pilot offer (4 weeks production): $30k credits, includes Optimize toolkit insights, two tuning sessions (2 x 2 hours) and cache telemetry.
2) Conversion paths: if FastShip signs Tier A within 30 days of pilot close we apply a 7% onboarding rebate against first quarter; Tier B -> 12% rebate + reserved KV retention slot; Tier C -> 18% rebate + dedicated pooling and a one-time migration credit.
3) Quantization concession: commit to a 12-month Tier B or greater and we include a one-time quantization audit + 10% commercial discount tied to a validated int8/int4 mixed plan (saves may be phased based on eval quality gates).

Operational/technical notes (for Marcus):
- Batching thresholds: given 60–70% sub-64-token requests, enable aggressive microbatching for short queries (target latency increase <15ms).
- KV-cache: set TTL to 30 minutes for session-bound caches; for high reuse endpoints we can extend to 6 hours with appropriate privacy controls. 
- Metric we use to qualify discounts: realized token-cost reduction measured over a 30-day window after tuning.

Link to internal sketch: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-term-sheet-draft

-Camila
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Park <olivia@fastship.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Legal - NebulaAI <legal@nebulaai.com>
Date: 2028-11-17T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit questions + packaging

Thanks Sofia / Camila — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- Can you make the pilot credits refundable if a blocker is found in week 2? We prefer a safety net while legal reviews SLAs.
- For compliance: we need a formal statement that KV-cache will not leak data across customers. Also, need an explanation of what "dedicated KV retention slot" means for Tier B (is it tenant-isolated memory? separate instance?).
- On quantization: can you share the quantization-cost-model.xlsx with the assumptions you used for the expected cost savings?

Legal is asking for a short form term sheet they can share with procurement — can you push the PDF with redlines turned on or a DocuSign-ready link?

Best,
Olivia

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Legal - NebulaAI <legal@nebulaai.com>
Date: 2028-11-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit questions + packaging — pilot term sheet and assurances

Hi Olivia & legal team,

Thanks for the quick questions. Below is a concise response and the next-step ask so procurement can move forward: 

1) Pilot credits: We can make the $30k convertible/refundable as follows — if a technical blocker attributable to Redwood (e.g., inability to reach agreed latency/throughput targets with the provided data) is identified during week 2 and we fail to remediate within 5 business days, the remaining unused pilot credits are refundable. This is intended to remove procurement friction while protecting both parties.

2) KV-cache/compliance: Dedicated KV retention slot means tenant-isolated cache storage and process isolation (no shared cache namespace). For FastShip Tier B or above we will provision an isolated cache instance with separate encryption keys; we will provide a short architecture note for legal and SOC review.

3) Quantization-cost-model.xlsx: attached is a conservative model with assumptions (token mix, hit rates, int8 vs int4 accuracy deltas). We recommend an int8-first deployment with a controlled 10% traffic split to int4 in staging; we will not recommend full migration to int4 for long transcripts without an agreed quality gate.

4) Term sheet & next steps: attached term sheet (optimize-toolkit-term-sheet-v3.pdf) — this is DocuSign-ready. Proposed path: sign LOI to start pilot (we can accept electronic signature), parallel legal review of the attached architecture note, and schedule a technical kickoff for Monday Nov 20 for runtime tuning.

Please confirm and we will generate the DocuSign envelope.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

Attachments: optimize-toolkit-term-sheet-v3.pdf (PDF, 28 KB); quantization-cost-model.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)
